{{otheruses redirect|Flameseeker Prophecies|the prophecies compiled by Glint|Flameseeker Verse|the Path of Fire achievement|Flameseeker Prophecies (achievement)}} {{Weapon infobox | uslot = Superior Sigil of Battle | type = shield | defense = 61 | level = 80 | salvage = none | bound = account use | skin = The Flameseeker Prophecies (skin); The Chosen (skin); Shield of the Wing (skin); The Chosen Experiment (skin) | rarity = legendary | prefix = selectable | id = 30696 | gallery2 = The Flameseeker Prophecies wielded.jpg | gallery2-text = Wielded. | gallery3 = The Flameseeker Prophecies footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Krytan letter footfalls. }} [[The Flameseeker Prophecies]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] shield crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. The shield contains motifs along the edges and an excerpt text in [[New Krytan]] (stylized form) paraphrasing the [[gw1:Flameseeker Prophecies|Flameseeker Prophecies]]. The prophecies, compiled by [[Glint]], foretold most of the events of ''[[Guild Wars|Guild Wars Prophecies]]'', from the fall of [[Ascalon]] to the unleashing of the [[gw1:Titan|titans]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|"The Flameseeker Prophecies" is an ancient tome containing near-complete proclamations of the future as foreseen by the dragon [[Glint]]. }} |} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 The Chosen | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of The Flameseeker Prophecies | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[The Flameseeker Prophecies]] is a golden shield with a book in the center. While drawn, the book on the front as well as the arm holding it and much of the shield's surface glows blue. ;Aura * The arm holding the shield has an aura of blue light around it. ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, a glowing blue page turns on the book. * When drawn, a burst of pale blue light followed by a spiral of [[New Krytan]] symbols will appear. * When drawn, a high-pitched sound could be heard. ;Footfalls * As your character walks, very faint light blue bursts will appear, followed by New Krytan symbols. ;Skill effects * Attacks cause a glowing blue page to turn on the book. '''Note''': This is no longer the case, and the page turning beyond the draw animation has not worked for well over 7-8 years, since PoF released. * Projectile skills will throw the book from the shield, with a blue/white trail and pages flying free. Unlike other projectile effects, [[Tides of Time]] retains its original animation as well as gaining the shields projectile. === Gallery === File:The Flameseeker Prophecies.gif|Animation. {{gww|Flameseeker Prophecies}} * New effects were added to this weapon with the [[Game updates/2015-12-01|1st December 2015 update]]. * The text visible on the tome is a compilation of quotes from [[gw1:Meerak|Meerak the Shouter]], an NPC in the original ''Guild Wars''. This text appears to be Meerak's own paraphrasing of the prophecies, as it does not match the phrasing on the [[Flameseeker Verse]]s found in [[Augury Rock]]. == See also == * [[The Flameseeker Prophecies I: The Experimental Shield]] * [[The Flameseeker Prophecies II: The Perfected Shield]] * [[The Flameseeker Prophecies III: The Chosen]] {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[de:Die Flammensucher-Prophezeiungen]] [[es:Las Profecías del Buscador de la Llama]] [[fr:Les Prophéties du Chercheur de la Flamme]]
